title: The Condition a Vehicle Was Already In and the Provisional Figure
content:
Damage a vehicle already carried before the loss is taken off the provisional figure a Keyturn Host Protection Plan claim is opened at, and how much is taken off turns on whether the vehicle has since passed an inspection.

- Where a defect was recorded on the vehicle in the six months before and no passed inspection has been recorded on it since that defect, the uncleared-defect share of 20 percent is taken off.
- Where a defect was recorded in that period and a passed inspection has been recorded on it since, the cleared-defect share of 8 percent is taken off.
- Where no defect was recorded in that period, nothing is taken off for the condition the vehicle was already in.

### A worked case (hypothetical figures)

On a figure of 20000 standing before this step, an uncleared defect leaves 16000, a defect cleared by a later passed inspection leaves 18400, and a vehicle with no defect recorded in the six months before leaves the figure at 20000.

### Points of judgement

| Defect recorded in the six months before | Passed inspection recorded after that defect | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 20 percent |
| yes | yes | 8 percent |
| no | either | nothing |

Where a passed inspection and a defect were recorded on the same day, the inspection is not earlier than the defect and the cleared-defect share governs.

### Where the facts come from

Defects recorded on the vehicle and the inspections passed on it are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle, a defect counting where it was recorded within the six months before the report.
